question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.order_time,
        t.topping_name
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT UNNEST(string_split(r.toppings, ',')) as tid
    ) st ON TRUE
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = TRIM(st.tid)::INT
    JOIN pizza_names n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
),
excluded_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.row_id,
        t.topping_name
    FROM orders o
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT UNNEST(string_split(o.exclusions, ',')) as eid
    ) e ON TRUE
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = TRIM(e.eid)::INT
    WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND o.exclusions != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.order_time,
        t.topping_name
    FROM orders o
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT UNNEST(string_split(o.extras, ',')) as eid
    ) e ON TRUE
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = TRIM(e.eid)::INT
    JOIN pizza_names n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT s.row_id, s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.pizza_id, s.pizza_name, s.order_time, s.topping_name
    FROM standard_toppings s
    LEFT JOIN excluded_names e ON e.row_id = s.row_id AND e.topping_name = s.topping_name
    WHERE e.topping_name IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
    FROM extra_toppings
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        topping_name,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
),
formatted_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        topping_name,
        cnt,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END as display_name,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as dup_flag
    FROM ingredient_counts
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        pizza_name || ': ' || string_agg(display_name, ', ' ORDER BY dup_flag ASC, display_name ASC) as ingredients
    FROM formatted_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, ingredients
FROM agg
ORDER BY row_id
